declarations.docstring: Builds an additive map from the displayed tensor-product quotient by evaluating a linear family of additive maps.
The uncurried map sends a pure tensor to the value obtained by evaluating the corresponding additive map.
Turns an additive map on the displayed tensor-product quotient into a linear family of additive maps.
Evaluating the curried map twice agrees with evaluating the original map on the associated pure tensor.
The functor from additive commutative groups to A-modules associated with a right A-module.
The A-module structure on additive homomorphisms from a right A-module to an additive commutative group.
The scalar action on additive homomorphisms from a right A-module.
Scalar multiplication of an additive homomorphism is evaluated by acting on its input through the opposite ring.
The adjunction between the displayed tensoring functor and the functor associated with a right A-module.
The displayed tensoring functor preserves finite colimits.
